candidats.titre: File:Dr. Cornelius and Elizabeth Harper Residence, Carroll Street, Mansion Hill, Madison, WI.jpg
candidats.description: Built in 1898, this Queen Anne-style house at 308 North Carroll Street in Madison, Wisconsin, was designed by Conover and Porter for the public health physician Dr. Cornelius A. Harper and his wife Elizabeth (see the Property Record online ). The house features a steeply pitched side gable roof, an eyebrow dormer window, wooden clapboard siding, a front porch with a front gable featuring decorative paneled trim, decorative columns, Gothic arched trim, clapboard-clad low railings, and a clapboard-clad base, one-over-one replacement windows, a three-story front bay window with a balcony on the t
